Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a kind boy named Tim lived with his mom and dad.
One day, Tim saw a small, helpless bird on the mountain. The bird could not fly because its wing was too heavy. Tim wanted to help the bird, so he asked his mom and dad to help.
Tim's mom and dad wanted to save the bird. They made a soft bed for the bird to rest and get better. After some time, the bird was strong enough to fly away. Tim was happy to see the bird go away. They all lived happily on the island.
